This valuation disconnect occurs despite monumental top-line acceleration, highlighted by trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of 413,940% and a year-over-year sales surge of 1,655,900% [E9, E44]. Furthermore, the company has established a positive medium-term trend with a 25% compounded profit growth rate over three years [E10], comfortably outpacing the sector median profit growth of 16.5% [E51]. Conceded: trailing twelve-month profit growth stands at -1500% alongside negative returns on capital and equity [E5, E6, E11]. However, this explosive revenue scaling and asset discount point to a deeply misunderstood operational turnaround that the current market capitalisation of ₹ 6.45 Cr fails to capture [E2, E45].

Tiaan Consumer Ltd presents a profile of extreme operational instability, characterized by a long-term decay in core business viability. While the company reports a massive spike in trailing twelve-month sales [E9], this is starkly contradicted by a 10-year compounded sales growth rate of -8% and a 5-year rate of -45% [E7, E8]. The company is currently destroying shareholder value, as evidenced by a negative return on equity of -2.0% and a return on capital employed of -0.0% [E5, E6]. Furthermore, the recent volatility has resulted in a catastrophic -1500% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E11]. Expectations have clearly decoupled from reality, as price growth is currently outpacing profit growth by 1481% [E33]. Conceded: [E1], [E9], [E10], [E44], [E45], [E47], [E51], [E52]. Investors should note that the stock provides no dividend yield to compensate for these fundamental risks [E3].

Conceded: [E3], [E5], [E6], [E7], [E8], [E11]. The bear focuses heavily on historical contraction, but completely ignores the extraordinary inflection point visible in trailing twelve-month sales growth of 413940% [E9] and screen reasons highlighting a staggering year-over-year sales surge of 1655900% [E44, E45]. This monumental top-line acceleration completely alters the forward-looking business reality, backed by a solid 3-year compounded profit growth of 25% [E10] and profit growth exceeding 20% year-over-year [E47]. The market capitalisation sits at a micro-cap level of just ₹ 6.45 Cr [E2] while trading at a discounted price-to-book ratio of 0.95x below book value [E1], meaning the market has severely lagged behind this massive operational turnaround. Furthermore, this dynamic top-line expansion is supported by robust sector tailwinds where sector median profit growth is 16.5% [E51] and sector median sales growth is 13.0% [E52], providing a thriving environment for Tiaan Consumer Ltd to sustain its newfound momentum.

Conceded: [E9], [E44], [E45], [E47]. While the bull points to astronomical trailing sales growth [E9, E44, E45] and positive 3-year profit growth [E10], this top-line surge has completely collapsed at the bottom line with trailing twelve-month profit growth plummeting by -1500% [E11]. The scanX signal engine explicitly warns that this is a price-led move where price growth exceeds profit growth by a staggering 1481%, proving that market expectations are running dangerously ahead of actual financial delivery [E33]. Furthermore, the long-term historical context of a -8% 10-year and -45% 5-year compounded sales contraction [E7, E8] reveals that the company's baseline is structurally declining rather than consistently compounding. Although the valuation sits at 0.95x book value [E1] for a micro-cap of ₹ 6.45 Cr [E2], this discount is fully warranted by negative returns on capital (ROCE of -0.0% [E5], ROE of -2.0% [E6]) and zero dividend yield [E3]. Sector tailwinds like median sales and profit growth [E51, E52] matter little when Tiaan Consumer Ltd itself delivers negative profitability [E6] alongside collapsing trailing profits [E11].
